ai_summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited delivered strong Q1 FY27 results, reporting an 18% year-on-year growth in Assets Under Management (AUM) and a 19% increase in Profit After Tax. The company also improved its asset quality, with Gross Non-Performing Assets (GNPA) decreasing by 3bps to 1.3%, alongside enhanced operational efficiency and a strategic focus on AI integration. No material red flags were identified, indicating robust financial health and a positive growth trajectory.
